verdict.headline: KOSPI hits circuit breaker as chip selloff deepens; TGT comps beat; FOMC Minutes at 2pm ET
verdict.label: Asian chip carnage triggers Seoul circuit breaker; TGT consumer beat; 30Y at 5.33% entering FOMC Minutes
verdict.rationale_short: The 30Y touched 5.33% overnight — a new 19-year high — as $432B in July deficit spending and $1.7T in corporate bond issuance sustain long-end supply pressure independent of rate expectations. KOSPI fell 6.39% and triggered the year's 48th circuit breaker before partially recovering; SK Hynix shed 9.93%, Samsung 7.54%. TGT reported +3.8% comparable sales vs. +2.4% consensus, raised full-year net sales guidance to ~5%, and is the session's clearest consumer signal entering WMT Thursday. FOMC Minutes at 2pm ET determine the path: fiscal-sustainability dissent pushes the 30Y toward 5.40% regardless of soft data; CPI-persistence-only dissent allows September odds to compress below 20% and the 30Y to retrace toward 5.20-5.25%.

FOMC Minutes at 2pm ET resolve the critical question: fiscal-sustainability dissent is not addressed by soft demand data and points toward 5.40%; CPI-persistence-only dissent allows five consecutive soft prints to constrain the move toward 5.20-5.25%.

bear_case: The 30Y printed 5.33% overnight — a new 19-year high above a close that already sat at 19-year highs. If the FOMC Minutes confirm the three dissenters (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) were primarily motivated by fiscal sustainability and Treasury supply absorption, that argument is structural and unaddressed by the five consecutive soft data prints since the July 28-29 meeting. A $432B July deficit and $1.7T in corporate bond issuance represent supply pressure that exists independent of inflation outcomes or policy rates. At 5.40% on the 30Y, duration-sensitive mega-cap reprices further — MSFT at 29x NTM compresses materially, and NVDA enters its August 26 print against a structurally higher discount rate. TGT's consumer beat offsets one session of macro pressure; it does not resolve structural supply-absorption dynamics in the long end. If SPX closes below 7,620 today, the August-low retest reopens. This read no longer holds if 30Y retraces below 5.20% on a CPI-persistence-only Minutes reading.
